svg.text: The add needs x5 in EX, but the load only has it at the end of MEM: the add and the
instruction behind it repeat ID and IF for one cycle, and a bubble goes into EX.
In cycle 5 the loaded value is forwarded MEM/WB → EX (orange arrow).
The branch is resolved in EX (cycle 3). The two instructions fetched after it are
turned into bubbles, and the target is fetched in cycle 4: a 2-cycle penalty.
stalled: repeats in the next cycle
